changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS sample_cug_prefix_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1;

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN prefixes.max_prefix IS NULL THEN setval('sample_cug_prefix_seq', 1, false) ELSE setval('sample_cug_prefix_seq', prefixes.max_prefix, true) END FROM ( SELECT MAX(split_part(cug_code, '.', 1)::bigint) AS max_prefix FROM sample_item WHERE cug_code IS NOT NULL AND split_part(cug_code, '.', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$' ) prefixes;
